title: StageArea: no Scale9Grid visual overlay when symbol selected
description: When a symbol instance with scale9Grid != null is selected on stage, Flash 8 draws 2 horizontal + 2 vertical dashed guide lines showing the 9-slice boundaries. There is no such overlay in packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx. Add: when selectedObject is a SymbolInstance and its symbol has scale9Grid, draw 4 dashed lines (2 horizontal at y = grid.top and grid.top+grid.height, 2 vertical at x = grid.left and grid.left+grid.width) over the stage canvas, offset by the instance's transform.
